title: API reference
lead: Package exports first, then what createDialect returns, then its options. Full explanations live on the other pages; this is the lookup table.
row_createDialect: Builds a dialect from the options below and returns the functions listed under “Returned by createDialect”. This is the entry for apps without SvelteKit.
row_createDialectKit: The same function for SvelteKit apps. It also fills in base from paths.base and resyncs the locale after client-side navigation. Everything exported from svelte-dialect is re-exported here.
row_Rich: Renders formatParts output. MF2 markup such as \{#link\}…\{/link\} goes to the snippet of the same name; markup without a snippet still renders its contents.
row_localizedEntries: Multiplies prerender entries across locales, base-free: SvelteKit prepends paths.base itself. This standalone version can be imported in vite.config.ts, which cannot load the dialect. createDialect returns a twin that takes only the paths and uses its own locales; it is the identity when routing is off.
row_t: Formats namespace:dot.path against the current locale (MF2). Params become required for keys typed via MessageParams.
row_loadTranslations: Caches namespaces for the current locale via loader, then resolves. reload refetches and replaces.
row_setLocale: Switches locale, updates <html lang>/dir and the cookie; under routing navigates to the new prefix unless reload: false.
row_configure: Replaces the locale set and/or the default locale after init. Invalid input warns and changes nothing.
row_locales: The selectable locales, taken from the message glob unless given. A live view: configure rewrites it in place.
row_handle: SvelteKit hooks.server.ts handle: negotiates the locale, isolates the request, fills %dialect.lang%/%dialect.dir% and sets Vary.
row_reroute: SvelteKit hooks.ts reroute: strips the locale prefix so routes match. Only meaningful with routing: true.
row_localizeHref: The address of a path in a locale, the current one by default. Identity when routing is off.
row_formatParts: The message as render-ready parts; MF2 markup arrives as open/close/standalone. Feed it to the Rich component.
row_formatNumber: Intl.NumberFormat for the active locale, memoised.
row_formatDate: Intl.DateTimeFormat for the active locale, memoised.
row_getTextDirection: Writing direction for a locale, from Intl. Current locale by default.
row_opt_messages: An import.meta.glob result. Eager entries are inlined; non-eager ones become per-namespace chunks. May be omitted when everything comes from loader.
row_opt_defaultLocale: The locale served on the bare path and used as the ultimate fallback.
row_opt_locales: Selectable locales. Defaults to those found in messages — set it explicitly when loading everything dynamically.
row_opt_cookie: A name, or \{ name?, maxAge?, domain?, secure? \}.
row_opt_loader: Fetches a namespace on demand — a database call, a fetch, a remote function.
row_opt_routing: Puts the locale in the URL as a path prefix.
row_opt_base: The app's base path when served from a subdirectory. svelte-dialect/kit fills it in from paths.base; set it yourself only outside SvelteKit.
row_opt_currentUrl: A reactive read of the current page URL, which resyncs the locale after client-side navigation. svelte-dialect/kit fills it in with page.url; leave it unset outside SvelteKit.
row_opt_detectOnBarePath: Redirects an unprefixed document visit to the visitor's own locale.
row_opt_strategy: Lookup order for the locale, first match wins.
row_opt_bidiIsolation: Wraps interpolated values in Unicode bidi isolates, for RTL locales.
row_opt_functions: Extra MF2 functions on top of the built-in set. Same name replaces one.
row_opt_onError: Receives every message error instead of the console.
